title_zh: 【能力聚焦】原理图仿真 · AI 生成原理图 · PCB 自动布线
title_en: [Focus] Schematic Simulation · AI Schematics · PCB Auto-Routing
body_zh: AI-SCH 仿真器面向 HarmonyOS NEXT，三大核心能力一站打通：原理图混合信号仿真与虚拟仪器验证；自然语言驱动的 AI 原理图生成（选型→布局→建网→布线→QA）；以及与编辑器同源的 PCB 自动布线，配合 2D/3D 板级检视，服务高校教学、竞赛训练与方案预验证。
body_en: AI-SCH Simulator on HarmonyOS NEXT centers on three capabilities: mixed-signal schematic simulation with virtual instruments; AI schematic generation from natural language (select → layout → net → route → QA); and editor-grade PCB auto-routing with 2D/3D board inspection — for education, contests, and engineering pre-validation.
